title: KING of Saints, to whom the number

lines.text: KING of Saints, to whom the number
Of Thy Starry host is known
Many a name, by man forgotten
Lives forever round Thy throne.
Holy, Holy /Holy, Holy/ Holy, Holy
be Thy name
To Thee all Honour and Glory
O Lord of Eternity.
Thou who art in the brightest light
Human eye can never scan
Thy back only shown to Moses
And his eyes like sun did shine.
Lights, which earth-born mists have darkened
There are shining full and clear
Princes in the court of heaven
Nameless, unremember‘d here
How they toil'd for Thee and suffer'd
None on earth can now record;
All their saintly life is hidden
In the Knowledge of their Lord.
All is veil’d from us, but written
In the Lamb's great book of life,
All the faith and prayer, and patience
All the toiling, and the strife.
There are told Thy hidden treasures
Number us, O Lord, with them
When Thou markest up the jewels
Of Thy living diadem
Kneel before the Glorious Father
Seraphim bend down for him
Before sacred Jehovah's Throne
Father God and Trinity.
Kneel before the Glorious Father
Cherubim bend down for him
Before sacred Jehovah‘s Throne
Father God and Trinity.
